verdict.rationale: Employee referrals are a fair capability to expect from an ATS like Lever, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a referral flow for employees: no submission, no status tracking, no referral visibility. The 'Create an application' API is a developer building block, and the 'built for all users' UI claim is an adjacent statement, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
